kind_why: Scene headings such as “SCENE 03 — THE UNEXPECTED ENCOUNTER” accompany acted action (“He quickly picks it up and runs after her.”) and character-labelled dialogue.
language_of_dialogue: Sinhala, with occasional English words and phrases.

problems.what: Sinhala characters are missing or misordered: “ඔයාෙ” is damaged, and the word for phone has displaced or missing vowel components.

where.quote: අෙන් , Thank you! මම දැක්ෙකවත් නෑ

problems.what: Sinhala vowel signs precede the consonants they belong to: “අෙන්” and “දැක්ෙකවත්” should read “අනේ” and “දැක්කෙවත්”.
Repeated misplaced Sinhala vowel signs; these words should read “බැංකුවෙන්වත්” and “කෙනෙක්ගෙන්වත්”.
“මෙ” is missing characters from “මගේ”; “දුවෙගන්”, “ෙවන්න”, and “ඕෙන්” also have displaced vowel signs.
Letters are missing in “මෙ වාපාරය” (intended “මගේ ව්‍යාපාරය”), and the initial vowel sign in “ෙගාඩනගා” is misplaced.
